questionText: The relative lowering of vapor pressure is equal to the

   $$\frac{p_1^0 - p_1}{p_1^0} = x_2$$
4. This relative lowering is directly equal to the **mole fraction of solute** ($x_2$).
Hence Option B is correct.

3. Increasing order of acidity: $\text{(B)} < \text{(A)} < \text{(C)} < \text{(D)}$.

   - **Steric effect**: Bulky alkyl substituents hinder the approach of the attacking nucleophile to the carbonyl carbon.
   - **Electronic effect**: Alkyl groups are electron-donating ($+I$), which disperses the partial positive charge ($\delta+$) on the carbonyl carbon, reducing electrophilicity.
2. Aldehydes have only one alkyl group and are much more reactive than ketones which have two alkyl groups.

   - Within aldehydes: Propanal ($CH_3CH_2CHO$, B) has a larger ethyl group than Ethanal ($CH_3CHO$, A). Thus: $\text{(B)} < \text{(A)}$.
3. Combining both hierarchies in increasing order: $\text{(D) Butanone} < \text{(C) Propanone} < \text{(B) Propanal} < \text{(A) Ethanal}$.
Hence Option C is correct.
